text:
anya: Quick thread (6m). We need a concise long-term routing + isolation positioning for the Q4 enterprise pack. sales needs a one-paragraph promise and measurable launch gates.

mason: From eng: keep it tiered (gold/silver/bronze). Map each tier to clear runtime knobs and acceptance tests.

sarah: Product ask: a one-pager with 3 things: what we promise, how to qualify, and the operational tradeoffs (cost uplift). simple language.

luca: Ops constraints: contractual isolation implies reserved slices, warm-cache onboarding, and an eviction choreography. We can ship policy templates (`reserved-slice`, `shared-guarded`, `preemptible-evict`) before a DSL.

dina: Sales wants one sample SLA bullet and an eligibility checklist for pilots. Also a short FAQ: "what happens on failover?"

mason: Proposed measurable gates: isolation_probe v1 (25k cross-tenant probes -> zero collisions), regional_latency_check (P99 within band under 70% load), failover_drill (RTO targets tiered: gold=45s, silver=90s, bronze=best-effort).

sarah: I'll draft the one-pager once eng confirms test names and ops provides template names and billing delta.

luca: Ops action: publish template names + brief runbook mapping runtime knobs to tiers (batching, cache, quantization). ETA Tue.

mason: Eng action: land minimal harness scripts for isolation_probe v1 and regional_latency_check and post README. ETA Mon.

dina: Sales action: validate the one-pager language with two pilot customers and return feedback. ETA Fri.

release-bot: Created ticket PROD-6120: "Routing & isolation: Q4 enterprise pledge + launch gates" assigned to mason.

anya: Great. We'll review the one-pager in Friday's roadmap review and freeze the gate list. Keep replies short here. :thumbsup:
